name: sshi_fbr
rationale: The reference FBR fails on power (S2, S4) and overvoltage (S3). I am adding a Parallel-SSHI (Synchronized Switch Harvesting on Inductor) circuit—consisting of an inductor and a switch—to flip the piezo capacitance voltage at its extrema. This significantly increases energy extraction efficiency, fixing the low vavg in S2 and S4. A Zener diode (DZ33) is added as a clamp to prevent the output from exceeding 3.6 V in S3.
